Three steps. Zero boxes to break down.

Cardboard is a one-way trip to the recycling bin — if it even survives the move. Totes go around again.

Step 1

Pick your package

Tell us roughly how many rooms you're moving. We'll size the tote count so you're not short on move day.

Step 2

We deliver, free

Totes show up stacked and clean, anywhere in Palm Beach County, on the date you pick. No delivery fee, ever.

Step 3

You move, we collect

Pack on your schedule. Once you're unpacked, tell us and we'll swing by to grab the empties — free pickup too.

Other move-related help

Declutter Service

Fill a tote with non-trash items you no longer want — no junk — and we'll take it away for you to be repurposed, rehomed, or simply donated. Lid must be able to close with items inside. Just $9 per tote.

Questions

Before you book

How big is a 27-gallon tote?

About 30" × 20" × 12" — roughly the same capacity as 2–3 standard moving boxes, but stackable, weatherproof, and strong enough to sit on.

Do I need to be home for delivery or pickup?

No. Tell us where to leave the totes (garage, front porch, lobby) and we'll do the same for pickup — just have them stacked and empty when we come by.

What if I need the totes longer than my package?

Extend week-to-week right from your booking confirmation email — no new booking required, and no penalty for going long.

Are the totes cleaned between rentals?

Every tote is washed, sanitized, and inspected for cracks before it goes back out. Damaged totes are retired, not rented.

What happens if a tote gets lost or damaged?

Normal wear is on us. Lost or badly damaged totes are billed at replacement cost — full details are in the rental agreement you'll review at booking.
